label: ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1: dependence reading, r is actual in x through a when x has both in act
definition: `DeflatedActualizedBy F x r a`: x has r in act and has a in act (F.InAct x r ∧ F.InAct x a). At a = esse it is the dependence ground of q.4 a.1 ad 3 ('nihil habet actualitatem, nisi inquantum est') read as a necessary condition. Distinguishing conditions: unlike ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2 it does not say that a is the act by which r is actual; views that recognize no act of being beyond instantiation grant it.
note: Stipulative analyst definition, attribution deferred; navigated from ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3, q.3 a.4 co. and De ente capp.3-4 (Baur/Koch), read in the materialized witnesses (docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md).
